CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S VISHWAJITH SHETTY  ORAL ORDER

Learned counsel for the petitioner, after arguing the matter for sometime, submits that the petition may be dismissed as withdrawn at this stage with liberty to the petitioner to file a fresh petition after examination of CWs.1 and 2 is completed before the trial Court.
2. Considering the age of the petitioner and period of his incarceration, efforts shall be made by the trial Court as well as the prosecution to examine CWs.1 and 2 on priority.
The petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.
